column1: # Only lines that the raw string catalog cannot express live here:
# mixed Chinese/English fragments, plural forms, locale attributes.
# Escapes: \n = newline, \t = tab, \\ = backslash. Prefix a line with # to comment it out.
chip.textContent = errs ? `${errs} issues to fix` : `${issues.length} notices`;
column2: chip.textContent = errs ? `${errs} issue${errs === 1 ? '' : 's'} to fix` : `${issues.length} notice${issues.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
